prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated large winning tests.
Home wait_info changes can be helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 8 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes can be helpful (3 winning tests in rounds 4, 6, and 15), though 11 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests (rounds 3 and 9).
Choose_path layout, finish copy, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, adoption new_flow, adoption hint, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Waiting Interactive Activity Studio Flow: Transform the rendering waiting screen into an interactive activity flow where users can explore pet actions while rendering completes. (why: Home wait time is very long (median 201s, mean 2336s). Giving users interactive activities reduces perceived waiting drop-off.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Quality Upload Inspection Screen: Add a new inspection screen right after photo upload to verify lighting and pet angle before starting generation. (why: Support receives emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong. A verification screen catches bad photos early.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray Control Shortcut Setup Screen: Insert a new screen during finish showing how to reveal, hide, and interact with the desktop pet via system tray. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who could not locate or control their pet after setup.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Pet Account Recovery Reassurance Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in restores existing pets safely without loss. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) is users worried about pets missing or reset after signing in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Status Progress Notification: Display explicit status progress and estimated rendering countdown on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait time is very high (median 201s, mean 2336s). Clear wait info has proven effective in previous test rounds.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Clarity Hint: Display a hint on the photo upload screen recommending clear front-facing lighting to prevent generation errors. (why: Support received emails regarding failed custom pet generation or distorted pet renders.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Hotkeys Welcome Guide Copy: Update headline and body on home_intro screen to clearly outline hotkeys and tray icons for controlling the pet. (why: Support theme: post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Preserved Pet Data Security Banner: Add a hint explaining that signing into existing accounts retains all previously created pets and customizations. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets upon re-authenticating.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Overview Card Grid Layout: Change choose_path screen layout to a structured grid layout displaying path options side-by-side with clear visuals. (why: Choose path step has 20.4% drop-off; a clean side-by-side grid helps users compare adoption options quickly.)
